text:
The first Arab Creativity Oscar, awarded to Mishary Alafasy in 2008, was sponsored by Amr Moussa, who was Arab League Secretary-General from 2001 to 2011. This rests on one search snippet attributing the sponsorship to Moussa (from Wikipedia), so I haven't verified it against a primary source. The team note that the answer is Ahmed Aboul Gheit or Nabil Elaraby conflicts with this: both took office after 2008, and I found nothing that supports either.

Sources: [Mishari bin Rashid Alafasy, Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mishari_bin_Rashid_Alafasy)

CONFIDENCE: 65
